The body style changed in 1979 and again in 1990. Notably, the front clips differ between models: from 1973 to 1980, all vehicles had one body style; from 1981 to 1987, another; from 1988 to 1991, K5 Jimmy and 1-ton and suburban models adopted a different style; and everything else through 1987 maintained the older body design.

The body style remained consistent from 1973 to 1987 (and 1988 to 1991) as noted previously. While there were changes in front styling around 1979 and 1990, this is common across many vehicle models. Similar transitions occurred with other cars like Camaros, Firebirds, Mustangs, and Challengers over their respective lifespans. Each model year saw minor adjustments, but they are generally classified under the same body style.
